page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with one Greek phrase set inline. No running head, marginal notes or catchword. Two small reference-like marks sit in the left margin, noted under notes.

main_text.p: Ecclesiae Romanae incunabulis, Pontifi-cum fere omnium, & illius Ecclesiae Doctorum auctoritate confirmata, & scriptis ubique terrarum disseminata reijcitur: Auctoritas Pontificum in subiectos sibi reliquarum Ecclesiarum Praesules conculcatur: potestas, atque facultas solis Romanis Pontificibus a Deo data infirmatur: & Romanus Pontifex manus dat? & suis etiam Oratoribus iniquitatem similem confirmabit? At lenianimo est Ioannes, non adversabitur. Esto lenis, ideo ne & stolidissimus omnium, & percussus, & exossatus silebit? non edet vocem? Quodsi ipse siluerit, an & successores tantam iniuriam aequo animo tulissent? Credant Schismatici. Sed successores conticuerunt. Ergo non fuit. Minutioribus restiterunt: facinus tam atrox non ita facile dissimulassent. In Ioannis Epistolis germanis, & non corruptis a Photio de Processione Spiritus, de non alterando Symbolo, de infirmandis Synodis Nicolai, Adriani, nec non Octava contra eundem Photium, nec verbulum est. page.notes: Two small marks in the left margin: one beside the line "bus restituerunt" (a small triangular mark) and one beside the Greek line (a dot-like mark). Neither is a readable note or reference; they are left out of the text. The Greek phrase is partly uncertain at the scan resolution; uncertain words are marked [?]. The "ß"-like long-s forms have been read as plain s throughout. Printed spelling "reijcitur", "Photij", "iniuriam" and "aequo" kept as printed. The page number reads "61" (printed as "6ı").
